title: PEB Mezzanine Floor System in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Add floor area inside your steel building with a mezzanine. Steel Mind Engineers designs and builds mezzanine floors for factories and warehouses in Pakistan.
h1: Mezzanine System: More Floor Area Inside Your Steel Building
quickAnswer: A mezzanine is an extra steel floor built inside a building. It adds usable area for offices, storage or production without enlarging the building footprint. Steel Mind Engineers built a 32,400 square foot mezzanine for Haier and a 7,020 square foot mezzanine for Maria B.
alt: Steel mezzanine floor with staircase and handrails inside a warehouse.

faq.q: Can a mezzanine be added to an existing building?
faq.a: Often yes, after an engineer checks the building structure and the floor.

faq.q: How high should the ceiling be?
faq.a: The engineer will check that both the lower and the upper floor have enough clear height for people and goods.

blocks.text: A mezzanine is an extra floor built inside a building. It uses the empty height above your ground floor. You get more area for offices, storage or production without a larger building footprint.

Columns carry the loads to the foundation. Main beams span between the columns and connect to the rigid-frame columns of the building. Secondary beams or joists carry the floor deck. The deck can be a steel sheet with a concrete topping, or a plate floor. Stairs and handrails give access.
The floor must be designed for its use. An office needs less load capacity than a floor with racks or machines. Tell the engineer the heaviest item that will stand on it.
A mezzanine adds usable floor area at a lower cost per square foot than a new building. Steel mezzanines are quick to install and can be extended or moved.

Steel Mind Engineers built a mezzanine floor of 32,400 square feet for Haier at Raiwind, 12 feet high, 180 feet wide and 180 feet long. It built a PEB mezzanine floor of 7,020 square feet for Maria B in Lahore, 12 feet high, 90 feet wide and 78 feet long. It also built a combined crane and mezzanine shed of 97,888 square feet.
